content: I am an AI assistant created by OpenAI that provides responses using GPT-3 technology. ChatGPT, on the other hand, is a chatbot using the GPT-3 model developed by OpenAI that can engage in conversations with users. While both of us use AI technology to interact with users, I am designed to answer questions and provide information, while ChatGPT is geared towards engaging in more general, conversational dialogue.
